statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: Only the badge line changed in README.md and README_zh.md; no prose requirement text was changed, but the badge is how the README states the framework requirement.

statements.proposition: This change brings the project up to current CI/CD standards while maintaining full backward compatibility.
statements.label: CANNOT_TELL
statements.note: 'Current CI/CD standards' is subjective. 'Full backward compatibility' is unsettled: the change raises every project's TargetFrameworkVersion from v3.5 to v4.0 (and the README requirement badge), which is a runtime requirement change for users with only .NET 3.5, but no concrete public-API break or failing build was observed, and I could not build the Windows/.NET Framework solution here.
